def test_search_users_valid():
    params = {"q": "Ada"}
    status, response = handle_search_users(params)
    assert status == 200
    assert len(response["users"]) == 1
    assert response["users"][0]["name"] == "Ada"

    params = {"q": "ex"}
    status, response = handle_search_users(params)
    assert status == 200
    assert len(response["users"]) == 2

    # Missing q
    assert handle_search_users({})[0] == 400
    # Not a string
    assert handle_search_users({"q": 123})[0] == 400
    # Blank string
    assert handle_search_users({"q": "   "})[0] == 400
"}
